Chat request with seed parameter for deterministic output; response includes system_fingerprint

```swift title="Swift"
import LiterLlm

let _req = try LiterLlm.chatCompletionRequestFromJson("{\"messages\":[{\"content\":\"Pick a random number\",\"role\":\"user\"}],\"model\":\"gpt-4\",\"seed\":42}")
let result = try await LiterLlm.chat(req: _req)
debugPrint(result.choices())
debugPrint(result.choices()[0].finishReason() as Any)
debugPrint(result.systemFingerprint() as Any)
```
